(normad)</b> · companion to NORMA-O 2.0<br><br>Says nothing about law: records <i>how</i> derived conclusions were computed and <i>under which assumptions</i>,<br>so that a derived graph is reproducible and cannot be mistaken for annotated fact.<br><br>Blue: normad terms · Yellow: imported (norma:, prov:, skos:) · Underlined: controlled values<br>Every instance is computed, never annotated, and lives in its own regenerable named graph.</div>" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="80" y="700" width="640" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

NORMA-O Derivation module (normad) · companion to NORMA-O 2.0
Says nothing about law: records how derived conclusions were computed and under which assumptions,
so that a derived graph is reproducible and cannot be mistaken for annotated fact.
Blue: normad terms · Yellow: imported (norma:, prov:, skos:) · Underlined: controlled values
Every instance is computed, never annotated, and lives in its own regenerable named graph.
